items.prompt: A volume field has missing data. When is replacing it with zero justified?

options.text: Always, because missing and zero are the same number
options.why: Missing supplies no observed numeric value.

options.text: Whenever it makes the graph look smoother
options.why: Visual neatness does not establish a field policy.

options.text: Only under an explicit field contract
options.why: The contract must justify the substitution and downstream effect.

options.text: Never for any field under any possible contract
options.why: Some interfaces can explicitly define absent activity as zero; the scope must be known.

items.explanation: A replacement needs a stated source/field contract. Do not transfer a rule for one field to every other field.
